'''Chapter 376''' is titled "I Got It!!!".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 14: "Hina Attacks".

Their disguises exposed, [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]]'s party scatter before [[Hina]]; soon, the Marine captain [[Ori Ori no Mi|ensnares]] [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]].

==Short Summary==
The group prepares to enter [[Enies Lobby]].

==Long Summary==
On the [[Rocketman]], [[Usopp]] introduces himself as Sogeking, a friend of Usopp and both [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] believe this despite the others pointing out that it is obviously Usopp. They continue to watch as Luffy and Chopper continue to fall for this act. [[Sanji]] interrupts them and informs them of the knowledge that [[Blueno]] gave them just before he escaped.

After hearing this, Luffy becomes more determined to save her. [[Paulie]] reveals that he has been to [[Enies Lobby]] before and reveals that he drew a map to remember where everything was. He states that if [[Franky]] and/or [[Nico Robin]] reach the [[Gates of Justice]], they will be unable to rescue them. They decide that the [[Galley-La Company]] and the [[Franky Family]] will charge in first to clear the gates, so the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] can avoid minor fights and can concentrate on the [[CP9]].

As they observe the size of the gates, they realize that Luffy has charged in on his own despite hearing the plan. The Franky Family and Galley-La Company chase after him while the [[Marines]] notice him only as an intruder. However, they soon find out his identity and [[Spandam]] orders them to kill him. As he easily defeats the guards, the Franky Family and Galley-La Company make it over the gate as the [[Rocketman]] prepares to make its way in five minutes time.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*Only [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] do not seem to know that [[Usopp]] is Sogeking.
*[[Sanji]] informs the group that [[CP9]] is using [[Nico Robin|Robin]]'s horrific past to blackmail her, and she would most likely be unwilling to leave on her own.
*The passengers of [[Rocketman]] all come up with a battle plan.
**They conclude that [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Franky]] must be saved before they pass the [[Gates of Justice]], as it is impossible to sail through the [[Calm Belt]] on the other side.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] separates from the group, invading [[Enies Lobby]] and engaging hundreds of [[World Government]] officials on his own.
*The [[Rocketman]] will charge through the gates of [[Enies Lobby]] in 5 minutes.
